parts.html: The K-17 standard model is a neoclassical U-shaped kitchen in a calm gray: classic aesthetics, solid-color fronts, and a modern compact laminate countertop.

Gray gives the kitchen a restrained, refined character. The neutral palette makes it easy to pair the furniture with light walls, natural wood, decorative plaster, stone textures, and metal accents. This makes the K-17 model suitable for modern apartments, spacious condos, and private homes.

The kitchen’s defining feature is its U-shaped layout: 6.7 linear meters of furniture along three walls. There are plenty of work surfaces and cabinets for dishes and food, while the center of the kitchen stays open — the model has no island.

In the K-17 model, special attention is paid to the combination of front materials. The upper cabinets are made of laminated chipboard, while the lower ones have a foil-wrapped finish. A single gray color unites the different surfaces into a cohesive composition, preserving the visual harmony characteristic of neoclassical style.
The kitchen carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
The cargo pull-out keeps food and small kitchen items close at hand. Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges close the doors smoothly, and the drawers run on concealed Muller runners.
The model is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included; lift-up mechanisms are not.
We make the K-17 to fit your kitchen: we adjust the cabinet sizes, the configuration of the U-shaped layout, and the appliance placement to suit your utility connections.
